answer: Use a lantern audit: each epoch, a random 5% of identities must pass a check proving a work history — a marble ledger of past jobs that cannot be copied between identities. Karst-style seepage fails because each history binds one device key to one task trail. An identity that fails or skips the audit is banned for 12 epochs, and its sponsors lose their slots too. Passing costs 20,000 POA per identity per epoch, so 1,000 fakes cost 20,000,000 POA per epoch while one honest agent pays 20,000 once. Limitation: honest newcomers with thin histories face a cold start and may be flagged unfairly.
